name: clawd-buddy
description: Clawd, Claude Code's pixel mascot, lives above your prompt: it acts out what Claude is doing, bubbles code while it types, dances to your music, and hops when you click it

language.title: Language / 语言
language.description: Language of the captions beside Clawd. auto follows your locale (LC_ALL, LC_MESSAGES, LANG): Chinese for zh_*, English otherwise. 小人旁边文字的语言,auto 跟随系统 locale。

chatModel.title: Chat model / 聊天模型
chatModel.description: Which model answers when you chat with Clawd (/clawd chat). haiku, sonnet or opus are told what Claude is doing and the latest of your conversation; main forks the session's own conversation on its own model, so it knows everything said so far. 和 Clawd 聊天时用哪个模型:haiku/sonnet/opus 会拿到当前情况和最近几句对话的摘要;main 分叉主会话,用主会话的模型,知道完整对话。
